'''Quen-Ton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] ally of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed in the [[Dorn Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], she managed the supplies of stimulants.
